name: embedded_serpentine
description: Embedded extrusion into a support bath: tangent-directed nozzle/wake lag, transient density drift, flow-to-radius bias and correlated path/radius errors. Optimizes 3-D nozzle offsets and filament radius with fixed target frames. Synthetic reduced-order model; not a fluid, gelation or collision simulation.

validation.interval_scope: MC sampling only; two-sided individual 95% intervals
